{{Otheruses|Canister}}
'''Anti-vehicle canisters''' were [[Flechette/Legends|flechette]] ammunition loads used in [[Flechette launcher/Legends|flechette launchers]] such as the [[FC-1 flechette launcher/Legends|FC-1 flechette launcher]]. They were specifically designed to be used against vehicles such as [[Speeder/Legends|speeders]] and retailed for a cost of two hundred [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="GFT">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>
